description: The visa status and the rules that apply to a trip: one destination country, one passport. Each rule has its official source. Use the country's ISO code or its English or Russian name.

destination.description: the country of the trip, e.g. TR or Turkey

items.description: what the traveller carries, if anything

lang.description: the language of the rule texts; en if left out

passport.description: the country of the traveller's passport, e.g. KZ or Kazakhstan

name: check_trip
title: Check a trip's entry rules
